# LisbonTuk4U

> LisbonTuk4U runs private, 100% electric tuk-tuk sightseeing tours in Lisbon, Portugal, guided by Susane, a certified local guide, in a blue tuk-tuk decorated with flowers. Prices are per group (up to 5 people per tuk-tuk), not per person, and include free hotel pick-up in Lisbon and free cancellation up to 48 hours before the tour. Commentary in Portuguese, English, Spanish, Italian and French. Booked and paid online at https://lisbontuk4u.com.

## Key facts

- Business: LisbonTuk4U (also written "Lisbon Tuk4U"), tuk-tuk tour operator in Lisbon, Portugal
- Guide: Susane, certified local guide in Lisbon
- Vehicle: 100% electric tuk-tuk, blue with flowers
- Tour type: private (only your group on board), never shared with strangers
- Capacity: up to 5 people per tuk-tuk; groups of 6 to 10 people get 2 tuk-tuks and the price doubles
- Start: free pick-up and drop-off at any hotel or accommodation in Lisbon or at the Lisbon cruise terminal, or meeting point next to the Hard Rock Café in central Lisbon
- Languages: Portuguese, English, Spanish, Italian, French
- Included: private electric tuk-tuk, certified guide, hotel pick-up and drop-off
- Not included: monument entrance tickets, food and drinks, tips, pick-up outside Lisbon (extra fee)
- Cancellation: free up to 48 hours before the tour
- Payment: online by card through a secure Stripe checkout, total price per group, no hidden fees
- Suitable for: all ages, families with children, couples, older travellers and people who prefer not to walk Lisbon's hills
- Rating: 5.0 out of 5 on Google (120+ reviews)
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +351 966 697 738, email lisbontuk4u@gmail.com

## Tours and prices (per group of up to 5 people)

- [Lisboa à la Carte](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/a-la-carte.html): tailor-made route, 1 to 5 hours; €120 (1h), €180 (2h), €240 (3h), €300 (4h), €360 (5h)
- [Lisboa Autêntica](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/lisboa-autentica.html): 1.5 hours, €150 — off-the-beaten-path Lisbon: Lapa, Madragoa, Estrela and Campo de Ourique, Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga, Tapada das Necessidades, Campo de Ourique Market
- [Belém](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/belem.html): 2 hours, €180 — Pastéis de Belém, Jerónimos Monastery, Belém Tower, Monument to the Discoveries
- [Centro Histórico (Historic Centre)](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/centro-historico.html): 2 hours, €180 — Alfama, Graça and the old town: Lisbon Cathedral (Sé), Santa Luzia and Portas do Sol viewpoints, Graça, Senhora do Monte, São Vicente de Fora, Feira da Ladra, National Pantheon
- [Lisboa Miradouros (Viewpoints)](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/miradouros.html): 3 hours, €240 — Lisbon's best viewpoints: Santa Luzia, Portas do Sol, Graça, Senhora do Monte, São Pedro de Alcântara, Parque Eduardo VII, plus Santa Justa Lift and Estrela Basilica
- [Half Day](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/half-day.html): 4 hours, €300 — the most popular tour: Alfama, Graça, Chiado, Bairro Alto and Belém in one trip
- [Full Lisboa](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/full-lisboa.html): 5 hours, €360 — the complete tour: historic centre, viewpoints, Estrela, LX Factory and Belém

## Cruise passengers

- [Tuk-tuk tour from the Lisbon cruise port](https://lisbontuk4u.com/en/tours/cruise-port.html): free pickup and drop-off at the Lisbon cruise terminal, private tours from 1.5 to 5 hours (€120–€360 per group), route planned around the ship's all-aboard time. The meeting point is agreed with Susane on WhatsApp after booking.

## Frequently asked questions

- How much does a tuk-tuk tour in Lisbon cost with LisbonTuk4U? From €120 (1 hour) to €360 (5 hours) per group of up to 5 people. The 2-hour Belém or Historic Centre tours cost €180 per group.
- Is the price per person? No. The price is per tuk-tuk (up to 5 people), so a family of 4 pays the same as a couple.
- Where does the tour start? Free pick-up at your hotel in Lisbon, or next to the Hard Rock Café.
- Can I cancel? Yes, free cancellation up to 48 hours before.
- Which languages does the guide speak? Portuguese, English, Spanish, Italian and French.
- Is it private? Yes, every tour is private: only your group is on board.
